About The Role

We’re looking for a LIMS Implementation Specialist to help laboratories select, configure, deploy, and improve Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS). You’ll work with laboratory teams, IT, project leaders, and vendors to translate operational needs into reliable workflows and support successful adoption.

What you’ll do

Gather and document laboratory requirements, workflows, and user needs.
Configure LIMS workflows, forms, test methods, sample plans, permissions, and reports.
Support data migration, system integrations, and interface testing.
Develop and execute test plans, document results, and help resolve issues.
Coordinate implementation activities, timelines, risks, and decisions with project stakeholders.
Create user guides and training materials; deliver training and support users during rollout.
Help maintain system documentation, change controls, and validation records as required.
Provide post-launch support and identify opportunities to improve system performance and usability.

What you’ll bring

Experience implementing, configuring, administering, or supporting a LIMS.
Understanding of laboratory operations, such as sample lifecycle, testing, results review, and reporting.
Ability to translate business and laboratory requirements into system workflows.
Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
Experience with user acceptance testing, data migration, or system integration.
Comfort working with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
